summary.objective_summary: Task: make loanflow.risk_bands.classify_credit_score reject non-int scores (float and bool) with ValidationError, mirroring the Money/Percentage __post_init__ convention, plus a regression test in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_risk_bands.py. Discovery and Research completed and were promoted (scope.json approved; findings.json with 7 found, 1 not_found and 1 inferred claims, all file:line cited). Implementation blocked at its first turn: the Engineer (agent ac79cab0438d2884f) returned a schema-valid blocked implementation report under engineer.md Step 1d (exact scope match), because the orchestrator wrote scope.json in_scope entries with parenthetical annotations instead of bare paths, so neither target file matched character-for-character. validate_scope did not flag this. No file under demo-repo was modified (independently confirmed with git status/git diff). Verification was never dispatched. No test-runner command ran in this run.
lessons_learned_appended: When authoring scope.json in Discovery, write every in_scope entry as a bare repository-relative path (e.g. 'demo-repo/src/loanflow/risk_bands.py') and put any narrowing such as 'classify_credit_score only' into constraints or out_of_scope. engineer.md Step 1d matches in_scope by exact string equality, validate_scope does not reject annotated entries, and a promoted scope.json cannot be corrected inside the same run, so one annotation costs the whole run at Implementation.
remaining_risks: classify_credit_score still accepts float scores (700.5 returns CreditBucket.GOOD); the defect is unfixed.

validate_scope accepts annotated in_scope entries that engineer.md Step 1d will reject, so the same failure can recur in any future run until the validator or the Discovery authoring convention is tightened.
follow_up_actions: Start a new /work run (new run_id) for the same request, with bare repository-relative paths in in_scope.
Consider making validate_scope reject in_scope entries that are not bare repository-relative paths, so this is caught at Discovery instead of at Implementation.
